title: Context management design: snapshot op, injection points, compaction hook
description: Write design/context-management.md (design document format, REQ-0054) defining: (1) the snapshot changeset op and its validation; (2) the layout of the chat prompt and coding-agent brief, in order: task next_action, task section, snapshot, with the snapshot marked as project state; (3) when the chat agent is asked to propose next actions and a snapshot Next; (4) how the snapshot is re-supplied after compaction, verified for headless 'claude -p --resume' chat turns and agent runs, with a fallback (re-supply every turn) if the SessionStart compact hook does not fire. The first run (b85a89d on reqforge/TASK-0041) wrote docs/context.md without front matter and did not test the hook: move and extend it rather than starting over.
done_when: design/context-management.md is committed with realises [REQ-0057, REQ-0058, REQ-0059], has a section addressing each acceptance criterion of REQ-0057 and REQ-0058 and REQ-0059 AC3-AC4, records the compaction-hook test result, and lint reports 0 unknown realises ids.
